title: Payment lifecycle moves a tenant through active, past due, suspended and deleted
description:
What: payment events change tenant state. Suspension keeps content and export available; deletion follows a stated grace period, never silently.
Acceptance:
Scenario: A failed payment suspends writes, not reading or export

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented by PPY-d7274f (state applied through token claims). Prospectus billing today never suspends an entitlement on its own (Prospectus docs/BILLING.md); whether past due suspends automatically is owner decision 5 in the design note, asked of Prospectus in PPY-6d9a6d.
